# Micro-Manager devices and properties

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_property_reference.py from the adapter's property registry -- do not edit. -->

The inSiliScope adapter is a hub (`inSiliScope`) with one device per part of the microscope. Every property has a
**tier**: the hub's pre-init `Detail` (Basic, Advanced or Expert) decides which tiers a session shows; a property
above it is not created and keeps its default. The shipped configurations `adapter/inSiliScope/config/inSiliScope_{Basic,Advanced,Expert}.cfg`
load the devices with their config groups (Channel, Objective, Camera, Quality, Drift, Specimen) and pixel-size
calibrations. Where a new property belongs, and the rules behind the tiers: `spec/MM_DEVICES.md` in the repository.
Micro-Manager's own properties (`Exposure`, `Binning`, `State`, `Label`, `Position`, ...) are not listed.

| Device | Type | Tier | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Hub` | Hub | Basic | inSiliScope: a simulated fluorescence/BrightField microscope (hub of its devices) |
| `Camera` | Camera | Basic | inSiliScope camera: a simulated sCMOS/EMCCD |
| `XYStage` | XYStage | Basic | Moves the field of view over the sample |
| `ZStage` | Stage | Basic | The focus: height of the focal plane above the coverslip (um) |
| `Objective` | State | Basic | Objective turret: NA, immersion, magnification, aberrations |
| `EmissionPath` | Magnifier | Basic | Magnification between objective and camera (sets the pixel size) |
| `FilterCube` | State | Basic | Filter cube: excitation filter, dichroic and emission filter as one choice |
| `ExcitationFilter` | State | Advanced | Laser clean-up filter wheel (the cube's excitation filter, set on its own) |
| `Dichroic` | State | Advanced | Dichroic mirror wheel (the cube's dichroic, set on its own) |
| `EmissionFilter` | State | Advanced | Emission filter wheel (the cube's emission filter, set on its own) |
| `Lasers` | Shutter | Basic | Laser engine and its shutter: line powers, beam profile, geometry |
| `TransmittedLamp` | Shutter | Basic | Transmitted-light lamp and its shutter (BrightField) |
| `SampleHolder` | State | Basic | The mounted specimen; drift and background of the sample |
| `CellField` | Generic | Basic | Specimen: a field of cells with their labelled structures |
| `Fluorophores` | Generic | Basic | The dyes: label mode, photophysics readouts, custom dyes |
| `Renderer` | Generic | Basic | How the images are computed: quality, GPU, caches, numerics |

## Hub

inSiliScope: a simulated fluorescence/BrightField microscope (hub of its devices).

| Property | Tier | Default | Values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Detail` | pre-init | Basic | `Advanced`, `Basic`, `Expert` | set before the devices initialize |
| `RandomSeed` | pre-init | 42 |  | set before the devices initialize |

## Camera

inSiliScope camera: a simulated sCMOS/EMCCD.

| Property | Tier | Default | Values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `FovSize` | pre-init | 256x256 | `1024x1024 (slow, ~4x the memory of 512)`, `128x128`, `256x256`, `512x512 (slower)` | set before the devices initialize |
| `CameraPreset` | Basic | Kinetix22 | `Kinetix22`, `iXonUltra897`, `Custom` | A camera model: sets the sensor type, QE curve, noise values, gain and sensor pixel. |
| `PixelSizeNm` | Advanced (read-only) | 97.45127436 |  | The pixel size in the sample: SensorPixelUm / (objective x emission magnification). |
| `SensorPixelUm` | Advanced | 6.5 | 0.5 .. 50 | The sensor's physical pixel pitch (um); the camera preset sets it. |
| `CameraType` | Advanced | sCMOS | `sCMOS`, `EMCCD` | The noise chain: sCMOS (per-pixel maps) or EMCCD (gain register, CIC); the camera preset sets it. |
| `QuantumEfficiency` | Advanced | 0.85 | 0.01 .. 1 | The QE where the QE curve is Flat (and for BrightField without a curve). |
| `QeCurve` | Advanced | Kinetix22 | `Kinetix22`, `iXonUltra897`, `Custom` | The QE curve the detected fractions use (a camera's FPbase curve, or Custom = flat). |
| `GainElectronsPerADU` | Advanced | 0.25 | 0.0001 .. 100 | Conversion gain, electrons per ADU, per photoelectron (an EMCCD's includes its EM gain). |
| `OffsetADU` | Advanced | 100 | 0 .. 10000 | The camera offset (ADU). |
| `OffsetStdADU` | Advanced | 0.5 | 0 .. 500 | The pixel-to-pixel spread of the offset (ADU, a static pattern). |
| `ReadNoiseElectrons` | Advanced | 1.2 | 0 .. 100 | Read noise, electrons RMS (an EMCCD's before the gain register). |
| `DarkCurrentElectronsPerSec` | Advanced | 1.03 | 0 .. 100 | Dark current, electrons per pixel per second. |
| `sCMOS_GainStdPctPerPixel` | Expert | 0.5 | 0 .. 50 | sCMOS only: pixel-to-pixel spread of the gain, % (a static pattern). |
| `sCMOS_ReadNoiseStdPctPerPixel` | Expert | 20 | 0 .. 100 | sCMOS only: pixel-to-pixel spread of the read noise, %. |
| `EMCCD_CicElectrons` | Expert | 0.002 | 0 .. 1 | EMCCD only: clock-induced charge, electrons per pixel per frame. |
| `EMCCD_EmGain` | Expert (read-only) | 4 |  | EMCCD only: the EM gain, the preset's pre-amplifier sensitivity / the gain (read-only). |
| `BitDepth` | Expert | 16 | 8 .. 16 | The ADC's bit depth (the EMCCD path clips to it). |

## Objective

Objective turret: NA, immersion, magnification, aberrations.

| Property | Tier | Default | Values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|

| `PsfZStepUm` | Advanced | 0.1 | 0.01 .. 1 | The z step of the PSF kernel's planes (um). |

| `WorkingDistanceUm` | Expert | 150 | 0 .. 9999 | Working distance (um; the JVM GibsonLanni model only). |

## SampleHolder

The mounted specimen; drift and background of the sample.

| Property | Tier | Default | Values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `DriftPreset` | Basic | Off | `Off`, `Low`, `Medium`, `High`, `Extreme`, `Custom` | How much the sample drifts: sets the xy and z drift speeds (0, 2, 5, 25, 250 nm/s) and random walks (0, 0.4, 1, 5, 50 nm/sqrt s). Custom = as set. |
| `DriftXySpeedNmPerSec` | Advanced | 0 | 0 .. 1000 | Directed sample drift in xy, mean speed (nm/s). |
| `DriftZSpeedNmPerSec` | Advanced | 0 | 0 .. 1000 | Directed sample drift in z, mean speed (nm/s); its direction: DriftZDirection. |
| `DriftXyNmPerSqrtSec` | Advanced | 0 | 0 .. 200 | Random-walk drift in x and y: RMS displacement after 1 s (nm), per axis. |
| `DriftZNmPerSqrtSec` | Advanced | 0 | 0 .. 200 | Random-walk drift in z: RMS displacement after 1 s (nm). |
| `BackgroundPhotonsPerSec` | Advanced | 0 | 0 .. 200000 | Uniform background (autofluorescence, out-of-focus light), photons per pixel per second. |
| `BackgroundDecaySec` | Advanced | 0 | 0 .. 100000 | The background fades to 30% with this time constant (s; 0 = no fade). |
| `DriftXyAngleDeg` | Expert | -1 | -1 .. 360 | Direction of the directed xy drift (deg; -1 = random per seed). |
| `DriftZDirection` | Expert | Random | `Random`, `Up`, `Down` | Direction the z drift starts in: Up = away from the coverslip, Down = towards it, Random = per seed. |
| `DriftXyAngleWanderDeg` | Expert | 180 | 0 .. 180 | The xy drift direction swings slowly within +/- this (deg; 180 = any direction). |
| `DriftZAngleWanderDeg` | Expert | 90 | 0 .. 180 | The z drift swings within +/- this (deg): speed x cos(angle); 90 = between full speed and still, 180 = also back. |
| `DriftSpeedWanderPct` | Expert | 0 | 0 .. 100 | RMS wander of the drift speeds, % of the mean. |
| `DriftWanderTimeSec` | Expert | 60 | 0.1 .. 100000 | Correlation time of the wanders (s). |
| `PsfSampleIndex` | Expert | 1.518 | 1 .. 2 | Refractive index of the sample medium in the Gibson-Lanni PSF (= immersion: no mismatch). |
| `PsfSampleDepthNm` | Expert | 0 | -100000 .. 100000 | Depth of the emitters below the coverslip in the Gibson-Lanni PSF (nm). |

## Renderer

How the images are computed: quality, GPU, caches, numerics.

| Property | Tier | Default | Values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Quality` | Basic | Realistic | `Fast`, `Realistic`, `Exhaustive`, `Custom` | Speed vs fidelity: Fast, Realistic (the reference settings) or Exhaustive. Custom: set by hand. |
| `UseGpu` | Advanced | On | `On`, `Off` | Render on the GPU (Direct3D 11) where a path exists; GpuStatus says which is used. |
| `GpuStatus` | Advanced (read-only) | Not used yet |  | What the camera renders on, or why the CPU (read-only). |
| `DiskCache` | Advanced | Cells | `Off`, `Cells`, `CellsAndPsf` | Keep packed cells (and the PSF kernel, ~200 MB) in the per-user cache directory between sessions. |
| `PsfModel` | Expert | GibsonLanniZernike | `Gaussian`, `RichardsWolf`, `GibsonLanni`, `GibsonLanniZernike` | The PSF model (GibsonLanniZernike: scalar Gibson-Lanni + Zernike pupil; RichardsWolf/GibsonLanni: JVM). |
| `PsfOversampling` | Expert | 6 | 1 .. 16 | PSF kernel samples per camera pixel. |
| `PsfInterp` | Expert | Cubic | `Nearest`, `Linear`, `Cubic`, `Fft` | Sub-pixel placement of the PSF (Fft: exact, slow, CPU only). |
| `PsfGeneratorJavaHome` | Expert |  |  | JRE/JDK root for the JVM PSF models (empty: auto-detect; read once per process). |
| `WideFieldUpscaling` | Expert | 1 | 1 .. 4 | Mean-field grid cells per pixel (WideField-mode populations). |
| `WideFieldZPlaneNm` | Expert | 25 | 5 .. 500 | Mean-field dye planes, nm apart. |
| `BrightFieldQuality` | Expert | 3 | 1 .. 4 | BrightField level 1-4 (sources, samples, slice step unless set below). |
| `BrightFieldSources` | Expert | 0 | 0 .. 1024 | Condenser source points (0 = the quality's). |
| `BrightFieldUpscaling` | Expert | 0 | 0 .. 8 | BrightField grid cells per pixel, a minimum (0 = the quality's). |
| `BrightFieldGeometrySamples` | Expert | 0 | 0 .. 16 | Geometry samples per grid cell (0 = the quality's). |
| `BrightFieldSliceUm` | Expert | -1 | -1 .. 5 | Multislice step, um (0 = one thin screen, -1 = the quality's). |
| `MeanFieldDensityPerUm2` | Expert | 20 | 0 .. 1000000 | Continuous populations denser than this render mean-field. |
| `MeanFieldSlabNm` | Expert | 500 | 0 .. 10000 | The density's z slab, nm. |
| `MeanFieldMaxEmitters` | Expert | 5000 | 0 .. 1000000000 | Populations with more emitters than this render mean-field. |
| `WriteScopeSpecTo` | Expert |  |  | Set to a file path: writes the engine spec of the current settings and stage pose there (insiliscope_cli --spec reproduces the frames). |

Created only when the process has the environment variable `ISC_TEST=1` (the test scripts in `tools/`), never
by `Detail`: the precomputed, seeded stack the reproducibility checks use, and tooling hooks.
